text_en: The Lord said to Moses, “Cut two tablets of stone like the former ones, and I will write on the tablets the words that were on the former tablets, which you broke.
text_cn: 上主向梅瑟说：“你要凿两块石版，和先前的一样；我要把你摔碎的石版上的字，再刻在石版上。

text_en: Be ready in the morning, and come up in the morning to Mount Sinai and present yourself there to me, on the top of the mountain.
text_cn: 明天早晨你要准备好，清早上西乃山，在山顶上站在我前。

text_en: No one shall come up with you, and do not let anyone be seen throughout all the mountain; and do not let flocks or herds graze in front of that mountain. ”
text_cn: 不准任何人同你上山，全山不可有一个人，也不准在这山下放牛羊。”

text_en: So Moses cut two tablets of stone like the former ones; and he rose early in the morning and went up on Mount Sinai, as the Lord had commanded him, and took in his hand the two tablets of stone.
text_cn: 梅瑟便凿了两块石版，和先前的一样；照上主的吩咐，清早起来，上了西乃山，手中拿着两块石版。

text_en: The Lord descended in the cloud and stood with him there, and proclaimed the name, “The Lord . ”
text_cn: 上主乘云降下，站在梅瑟身旁，他便呼喊"雅威"名号。

text_en: The Lord passed before him, and proclaimed, “The Lord , the Lord , a God merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love and faithfulness,
text_cn: 上主由他面前经过时，大声喊说：“雅威，雅威是慈悲宽仁的天主，缓于发怒，富于慈爱忠诚，

text_en: keeping steadfast love for the thousandth generation, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, yet by no means clearing the guilty, but visiting the iniquity of the parents upon the children and the children’s children, to the third and the fourth generation. ”
text_cn: 对万代的人保持仁爱，宽赦过犯、罪行和罪过，但是决不豁免惩罚，父亲的过犯向子孙追讨，直到三代四代。”

text_en: And Moses quickly bowed his head toward the earth, and worshiped.
text_cn: 梅瑟急忙俯伏在地朝拜，

text_en: He said, “If now I have found favor in your sight, O Lord, I pray, let the Lord go with us. Although this is a stiff-necked people, pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for your inheritance. ”
text_cn: 说：“吾主，若是我真在你眼中得宠，求吾主与我们同行；这百姓固然执拗，但求你宽免我们的过犯和罪恶，以我们为你的所有物。”

text_en: He said: I hereby make a covenant. Before all your people I will perform marvels, such as have not been performed in all the earth or in any nation; and all the people among whom you live shall see the work of the Lord ; for it is an awesome thing that I will do with you.
text_cn: 上主说：“看，我要立约：我在你的全百姓前所要行的奇迹，是在普世万国未行过的；你四周的人民要看见上主的作为，因为我藉你所行的是可怕的事。

text_en: Observe what I command you today. See, I will drive out before you the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
text_cn: 你应注意我今日吩咐你的事：我要从你面前驱逐阿摩黎人、客纳罕人、赫特人、培黎齐人、希威人和耶步斯人。

text_en: Take care not to make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which you are going, or it will become a snare among you.
text_cn: 你要注意：你每到一地，不可与那地方的居民立盟，恐怕他们成了你中间的陷阱。

text_en: You shall tear down their altars, break their pillars, and cut down their sacred poles
text_cn: 你应拆毁他们的祭坛，打碎他们的神柱，砍断他们的木偶。

text_en: (for you shall worship no other god, because the Lord , whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God).
text_cn: 不准你朝拜别的神，因为上主名为忌邪者，他是忌邪的天主。

text_en: You shall not make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, for when they prostitute themselves to their gods and sacrifice to their gods, someone among them will invite you, and you will eat of the sacrifice.
text_cn: 不准你与当地的人民结盟，免得他们与自己的神行淫，给自己的神献祭时，请你去吃他们的祭物，

text_en: And you will take wives from among their daughters for your sons, and their daughters who prostitute themselves to their gods will make your sons also prostitute themselves to their gods.
text_cn: 又免得你为你的儿子娶他们的女儿为妻；当他们的女儿与自己的神行淫的时候，也使你的儿子与她们的神行淫。

text_en: You shall not make cast idols.
text_cn: 不准为你铸造神像。

text_en: You shall keep the festival of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month of Abib; for in the month of Abib you came out from Egypt.
text_cn: 你要按照我所吩咐的，在阿彼布月所定的日期内，守无酵节，七天之久吃无酵饼，因为在阿彼布月你出离了埃及。

text_en: All that first opens the womb is mine, all your male livestock, the firstborn of cow and sheep.
text_cn: 凡初开母胎的都应归于我；你的牲畜中，凡首生的公牛羊，都应归于我。

text_en: The firstborn of a donkey you shall redeem with a lamb, or if you will not redeem it you shall break its neck. All the firstborn of your sons you shall redeem. No one shall appear before me empty-handed.
text_cn: 首生的驴，应用羊赎回；若不赎回，应打断它的颈项。你的子孙中，凡是长子，你应赎回。空着手的，不可到我台前来。

text_en: Six days you shall work, but on the seventh day you shall rest; even in plowing time and in harvest time you shall rest.
text_cn: 你六天作工，但第七天应安息，连在耕种收获的时期，也要安息。

text_en: You shall observe the festival of weeks, the first fruits of wheat harvest, and the festival of ingathering at the turn of the year.
text_cn: 在收获初熟麦子时，应过七七节；在年尾过收藏节。

text_en: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord God, the God of Israel.
text_cn: 凡你所有的男子，一年三次应去朝拜主，上主，以色列的天主。

text_en: For I will cast out nations before you, and enlarge your borders; no one shall covet your land when you go up to appear before the Lord your God three times in the year.
text_cn: 几时我从你面前赶走异民，扩展了你的疆域之后，你一年三次上去朝拜上主你天主的时候，没有人敢图谋你的国土。

text_en: You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leaven, and the sacrifice of the festival of the passover shall not be left until the morning.
text_cn: 不可同酵面一起给我祭献牺牲的血；逾越节的牺牲，不可留到早晨。

text_en: The best of the first fruits of your ground you shall bring to the house of the Lord your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother’s milk.
text_cn: 你田中最上等的初熟之果，应献到上主你的天主的殿中。不可煮羊羔在其母奶之中。”

text_en: The Lord said to Moses: Write these words; in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel.
text_cn: 以后上主向梅瑟说：“你要记录这些话，因为我依据这些话同你和以色列子民立了约。”

text_en: He was there with the Lord forty days and forty nights; he neither ate bread nor drank water. And he wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.
text_cn: 梅瑟在那里同上主一起，停留了四十天四十夜，没有吃饭，也没有喝水；把盟约的话，即十句话，写在石版上。

text_en: Moses came down from Mount Sinai. As he came down from the mountain with the two tablets of the covenant in his hand, Moses did not know that the skin of his face shone because he had been talking with God.
text_cn: 梅瑟从西乃山下来的时候，手中拿着两块约版；他下山的时候，未发觉自己的脸皮，因同上主谈过话，而发光。

text_en: When Aaron and all the Israelites saw Moses, the skin of his face was shining, and they were afraid to come near him.
text_cn: 亚郎和全以色列子民一看见他的脸皮发光，都害怕接近他。

text_en: But Moses called to them; and Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation returned to him, and Moses spoke with them.
text_cn: 梅瑟召呼他们过来，亚郎和全会众的首领才敢回到他跟前，梅瑟就同他们谈了话。

text_en: Afterward all the Israelites came near, and he gave them in commandment all that the Lord had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
text_cn: 以后全以色列子民也来到他跟前，他把上主在西乃山上同他所说的一切，都吩咐了他们。

text_en: When Moses had finished speaking with them, he put a veil on his face;
text_cn: 梅瑟向他们讲完话，就用首帕蒙上自己的脸。

text_en: but whenever Moses went in before the Lord to speak with him, he would take the veil off, until he came out; and when he came out, and told the Israelites what he had been commanded,
text_cn: 几时梅瑟到上主台前去同他谈话，就揭去首帕，直到出来的时候；他出来后，就对以色列子民讲明上主吩咐他的事，

text_en: the Israelites would see the face of Moses, that the skin of his face was shining; and Moses would put the veil on his face again, until he went in to speak with him.
text_cn: 以色列子民观看梅瑟的脸，见梅瑟的脸皮发光。以后梅瑟再用首帕蒙上自己的脸，直到再去同上主谈话。
